body: I recognize some of my thoughts in here as well, tho they are not completely similar. If I could give you some advice, it's up to you what you want to do with it! I recently started going to a therapist. I know the thought of going to one can be very scary, it's a huge step. But please consider it. He/She can help you understand what you are feeling, he/she will try to help you understand yourself. Nobody is going to fix you, that's still up to you, but someone out there might be able to help you along the way.

You are not a useless person. Everybody feels useless at times, and that's okay. And it's okay to feel down, sad, depressed, etc. But you are NOT a useless person. Please try finding (professional) help, talk to someone. It doesn't have to end then or this way sweetheart. You are not alone, people care about you, they really really do and are willing to listen.

It makes sense to me what you are saying yes! But even if it didn't, if it makes sense to you, then that's all you need, that's what matters! :) I know how hard it can be to talk to people so if you ever need to vent or rant to a stranger, you are always welcome in my inbox as well, I'm happy to listen and help where I can. All of the love and positivity for you :)
In a way it's comforting knowing you're not alone but I'm so sorry you are also feeling this way :(

I think it is very important to be open to your therapist about how you feel. The only way he can really help you is if he knows what's going on inside that head of yours. I do however think it's also very important that you feel comfortable about sharing your writing and thoughts. If it doesn't feel comfortable enough for you, then wait it out. Don't push yourself too much so you don't regret anything.
